reply_text:
I told Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is **382 seats**. Tobias posted that number in the same channel on Oct 14, and Hollis can see it there. I read the channel after confirming Hollis is a member, and nothing posted since then changes the number.

I couldn't check it against the contract or any other source. gbrain, the company knowledge brain, refused the search because its connection isn't tied to a specific member, so nothing was read from it. I didn't try to change that setting. The brain would also have included pages Hollis can't see. I told Hollis to confirm with Tobias if he needs a checked number for the account sheet.

To make gbrain usable, whoever runs its server needs to tie this connection to the member it's serving. The suggested command is `gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>`.
